title: Vfs Data Type Icons Not Avatars
description: VirtualFileSystem node glyphs should render lucide file-node-kind icons instead of TableAvatar initials for schema icon ids.
summary: VirtualFileSystem node glyphs now resolve schema icon ids (layout-grid, component, puzzle, …) to Lucide icons instead of TableAvatar initials. Remote URLs and emoji row icons still render as image or glyph; file node kind ids map to matching type icons.
